about_the_game:
Join Iria, a brave princess who not only must face dangerous enemies and overcome challenging obstacles, but also has a very special mission: to make it to her own birthday on time! 🎂✨ In this third-person action-adventure game, you'll explore vibrant environments filled with enemies, puzzles, and secrets to discover. With dynamic combat and challenging platforming, each level will test you as you progress through Iria's story, which combines humor, magic, and epic moments.

This version offers the first level of the game, along with a pair of quests and a final boss.

Key Features:

  • 🌟 Dynamic Combat: Use melee attacks and special abilities to defeat increasingly difficult enemies.

  • 🗺️ Explore varied environments: From enchanted forests to ruined castles, each area offers unique challenges.

  • 🎯 Objectives and Progression: Complete main and side quests that unlock new areas and rewards.

  • 👑 Challenging Bosses: Face unique enemies with special mechanics that will test your reflexes.

  • 🎂 A Fun and Lighthearted Story: Help Iria complete her mission against the clock before her birthday party is over.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Pentium G2030/AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 2500 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD Ryzen 3 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
